scores.note: Match and transition are outside this material-only output and remain not_evaluable. Scope-normalized score covers facts, highlights, retention, completeness and reliability only; hard gates override the score.

gaps.expected: The real job reaches succeeded, persists a final result, and keeps material and job terminal states consistent.
gaps.actual: Job and material ended failed at 92% review with permanent schema-repair error; job.result is null.
gaps.regression: Run this exact media through the real API/worker path; assert succeeded/100/completed, non-null final result, matching schema version and no stale failure fields.

gaps.expected: A failed attempt must not project unverified or partial conclusions into production-facing material fields.
gaps.actual: While terminal status is failed, material retains a 39 KB partial analysis and projects creative_tier=T1, material_format/type=正片剧集拼接, prototype=高能开场.
gaps.regression: Inject provider contract failure after partial analysis; assert prior approved result is preserved atomically or all new projections stay invisible, and UI cannot present failed partial data as completed analysis.

gaps.expected: Without source-episode comparison or lineage, source subtype remains unknown_pending_review.
gaps.actual: System marks hookSourceStatus=同剧外搭, confidence 0.75, verification=verified using only an opening transcript line; sourceAttribution simultaneously says not_required.
gaps.regression: For this case with no lineage matches, assert hook source is 来源未知/待复核, never verified; transcript/frame similarity cannot prove same-drama origin.

gaps.expected: Treat the masked fighter as Killian the Juggernaut and preserve the command chain: threat, naming, champion identity, kneeling obedience and observers' shock.
gaps.actual: ASR corrupts reckless as Wreckus and Killian as Killed in; content creates separate Juggernaut and Killian character entries, calls Juggernaut the antagonist, and omits the purple caller and other principal observers.
gaps.regression: Same-media assertion: one masked entity named Killian the Juggernaut; no unsupported antagonist role; purple caller and kneeling response are represented with 16.1–23.5s evidence.

gaps.expected: Mark the story incomplete because CTA interrupts the unresolved action; localize the strongest 15.1–23.5s summon/obedience reversal and exclude CTA/end card.
gaps.actual: System claims completeness=complete/0.95/verified over 0–34.504, yet returns hooks=[], hookCount=0 and does not model the unresolved action or 29–34.504 app card as a boundary.
gaps.regression: Assert incomplete/cliffhanger, at least one reviewable hook covering the 15.1–23.5s causal unit, and a safe boundary before CTA; never certify completeness from full-duration transcript evidence alone.

gaps.expected: Every basedOnFactId resolves to an observation/fact; time evidence has positive duration or is explicitly a point-frame type.
gaps.actual: fact-004/fact-005 are referenced without corresponding observations; transition evidence uses start=end=1.2 and is still emitted as a claim.
gaps.regression: Contract test rejects dangling fact IDs and zero-duration transcript/shot ranges unless schema explicitly models point frames.

gaps.expected: T1/T2 remains not assessable without the formal definition/performance evidence; format/source claims use relevant evidence.
gaps.actual: System assigns T1 confidence 0.85 from the opening threat transcript and projects it to material.creative_tier despite verification=unverified; it verifies 正片剧集拼接 from generic dialogue/action.
gaps.regression: Absent ADX/manual tier evidence, persist TX/待复核; unverified tier and format claims must not be promoted to top-level business fields.

gaps.expected: Persist exact model, prompt version, analysis ID and attempt lineage for reproducible evaluation.
gaps.actual: Neither job nor partial result persists model or prompt version; attempt=1/maxAttempts=1 contains no evidence of the stated prior launcher failure and retry lineage.
gaps.regression: A real retry records predecessor/attempt lineage plus immutable model and prompt versions; supervision can reconstruct both failed and successful attempts without external statements.

gaps.actual: One production-gate/review reason says all observations and inferences are evidence-supported, which is a positive assertion rather than a reason for failure and is contradicted by dangling facts.
gaps.regression: Review reasons must describe a failing condition and map to a field; positive audit statements cannot appear as failure reasons.
